title: Tracking Shot
description: A tracking shot moves with, beside, ahead of, or behind a moving subject, typically matching pace on a parallel path. The person supplies the motion; the camera keeps distance, height, and scale while foreground, mid-ground, and deep background peel.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Accompany a walker. The picture is not a postcard of a person; it is duration spent in their path.

Side-on tracking keeps cause, distance, and fatigue visible, which is why corridor fights and long walks live here. It is the wrong tool for a seated confession, and the wrong tool if you only panned from a locked tripod with a long lens.
If foreground does not slide, you did not track.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Use dolly, Steadicam, gimbal, or vehicle on a path parallel to the action. Match speed.
Hold a consistent distance and shoulder height unless the story changes rank. One direction.
Prompt a lateral tracking shot, camera matching pace on a parallel path, shoulder height, parallax of three planes.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: Use it to accompany a walker through space that must stay readable. Concrete beat: a side-on corridor fight in which exhaustion is as visible as the hits.
Do not track a still interrogation.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: A Follow Shot trails behind, using the back of the head as foreground. A Walk and Talk is tracking put to conversation coverage.
Steadicam is a support that often executes tracks. A Dolly Left can track a still line; tracking as a job is subject-locked travel.
Do not confuse it with a static telephoto pan.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Touch of Evil opens with a long traveling sentence. Children of Men and 1917 keep geography continuous while people move.
Oldboy's hammer fight is predominantly side-on tracking in a narrow corridor. The 400 Blows ends on Antoine's run toward the sea.
Grammar of matched pace, not a stunt to copy.

sections.title: Prompt it

blocks.text: Lateral tracking shot of [Subject], camera matching pace on a parallel path, shoulder height, parallax of foreground, mid-ground, and deep background. For motion: the camera tracks alongside [Subject] at walking pace, holding a consistent distance.

Side-on continuous shot of a tired security guard trying to pass three obstructing figures in a narrow service corridor. Choreographed non-graphic action, visible pauses and fatigue, full bodies readable, camera tracks only laterally. No rapid edits, no impossible acrobatics, no concealed geography.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: The usual wrong cousin is a Pan Left from a locked head, or a Slow Zoom In that only changes size. The tell is no sliding foreground.
The fix: a traveling support, matching pace, near objects passing.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Tracking Shot in film?
It is a camera move that travels with a subject, usually matching their pace and holding distance so the world slides past in parallax.
Tracking Shot vs Follow Shot
Follow typically sits behind and uses the back of the head as a foreground. Tracking is the broader job and often rides beside, keeping a side-on view of action.
When should I use Tracking Shot?
When walking, running, or fighting must stay continuous in space. Do not use it for a seated scene that only needed a slow push.
How do I prompt Tracking Shot for AI image or video?
Write camera tracks alongside [Subject] at matching pace, consistent distance, shoulder height, foreground parallax. One direction. No tripod pan.
